title: Canonical Machine-Validated Agent Handoff Record
description: Machine-validated structured handoff envelope returned by every agent or workflow stage according to Section 10 of the architecture specification.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task associated with this handoff

agent_role.description: Name or persona role of the executing agent

stage.description: Workflow lifecycle stage (e.g. INTAKE, DISCOVERY, VERIFICATION)

status.description: Execution status outcome for this handoff

summary.description: Executive summary of results and findings

claims.description: List of factual or derived claims produced by the agent

evidence_refs.description: Evidence record IDs supporting claims and verification

files_inspected.description: Paths to files inspected during execution

files_changed.description: Paths to files created, modified, or deleted

commands_run.description: Deterministic commands executed during workflow step

limitations.description: Known omissions, untested paths, or operational limitations

security_concerns.description: Security risks, trust boundary notes, or policy considerations

next_action.description: Recommended next step or handoff target

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when handoff was created
